prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection in Houston, heading east on a four-lane road. The light had been green for me as I came up to it.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw a car coming from the left side, but I thought it was going to stop. It didn't, and it hit my driver's side door.

Q: How fast do you think you were traveling?

A: Maybe around the posted limit, thirty-five or so. I wasn't speeding.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbag on my side went off.

Q: Where do you feel injured?

A: My right shoulder mostly. I hit the armrest and the door frame. It hurts when I lift my arm above my head, and I've had trouble sleeping on that side.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or gone to an urgent care facility since the accident?

A: I went to the emergency room that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about what happened?

A: Only that the other driver seemed to apologize at the scene, and I took a photo of both cars before they were towed.

Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with you about the photos and your medical records. That concludes the statement.

A: Okay, thanks.
